research_question: Which rice line among the 904 candidates has the highest measured 100-grain weight (GRWT100)?
control_variables: model=rice_gs Ridge alpha=1000 on top-2000 variance SNPs
20 oracle queries spent on top-20 model predictions
uncertainty: E3 measurement error not reported; model prediction uncertainty for the 884 unmeasured lines is high (Spearman 0.454).
conclusion: Rediscovered IRIS_313.12254 as the candidate with the highest measured 100-grain weight (5.0 g) among the 904 candidates, by ranking all candidates with the rice_gs genomic prediction model and phenotyping (E3 oracle) the top-20 predicted lines.
limitations: Genomic predictions are E1 model estimates, not phenotypes

linear Ridge on pruned SNPs, single environment, imputed markers (Spearman ~0.45). Only 20 of 904 candidates were measured, so a truly higher-measured line outside the top-20 predicted set cannot be excluded
the claim of 5.0 g max is conditioned on the model-ranking prior. Top-20 selection relies on model-card reported top-20 quartile hit of 1.00.
